name: landmine lateral raise
description: A raise done with a barbell anchored in a landmine setup, lifting out and up to shoulder height. It works the shoulders with a smooth arc.
instructions: Stand side-on to a landmine with your feet hip-width apart.
Hold the end of the bar in the hand nearer the anchor, arm straight by your hip.
Raise the bar out to the side and up until your arm points overhead, keeping it straight.
Lower it slowly back to your hip.
Finish the reps, then turn around and switch arms.
